items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: But he left Zack Whyte and went to Andy Kirk and the 12 Clouds of Joy, and that's how I got in Zack Whyte's band.

ctx.x: -- John Kirby, sure, and Walter Johnson. Oh, my goodness. I heard them out to -- they played a party out to Walnut Hill for some rich people and I went out there that night to hear the band. I was astounded because I'd never heard nothing like that.

The only other band that I heard that impressed me was that same year when I was with Zack White. I heard Duke Ellington's band. They came to Cincinnati and they was on the way from California -- they had just made the picture 'Check and Doublecheck' with Amos and Andy -- and they only had five brass at that time and just three saxophones. The brass was Whetsol, Metzel and Cootie Williams and Freddie Jenkins. That was the trumpets.
